title: Wormhole admissibility boundary
statement: A shortcut relation is physically admissible only when both mouths and the link are generated adjacent support with a positive source and complete causal trace; a named remote identification without that construction is rejected.
generation_rule: Generate the complete eight-axis product for wormhole admissibility boundary from carrier, dependency, relation, enumeration, minimality, measurement direction, record and extension.
grammar_boundary: Every finite exact carrier and causal/source ledger named by this law together with the complete product of its eight registered binary form axes.

choices.name: imported-spacetime-object
choices.reason: The object has no generated Fold provenance.

choices.name: generated-exact-Fold-carrier
choices.reason: Every carrier is regenerated from exact admitted support.

choices.name: asserted-prior-answer
choices.reason: A prior answer is not a V3 premise.

choices.name: admitted-V3-root-trace
choices.reason: Every dependency has an engine receipt to the root theorem.

choices.name: declared-remote-mouth-equivalence
choices.reason: The alternative loses conservation, causality or a required record.

choices.name: positive-source-generated-link-complete-causal-trace
choices.reason: A genuine new adjacency must enter the same source and causal ledgers as every other path.

choices.name: selected-neighbourhood
choices.reason: A selected neighbourhood cannot prove uniqueness.

choices.name: complete-registered-product
choices.reason: Every axis choice occurs with every other choice.

choices.name: uncontrolled-omission
choices.reason: An omitted carrier may silently choose the answer.

choices.name: every-omission-rejected
choices.reason: Each required carrier has a constructive omission failure.

choices.name: target-visible-before-seal
choices.reason: Target access reverses the empirical direction.

choices.name: formal-result-sealed-first
choices.reason: External comparison occurs only after the formal seal.

choices.name: answer-only
choices.reason: An answer cannot reproduce its causal/source ledger.

choices.name: complete-causal-source-control-record
choices.reason: Causal paths, sources, exact arithmetic, census and controls remain held.

choices.name: free-extra-rule
choices.reason: An extra selector is a free parameter.

choices.name: no-extra-rule
choices.reason: The declared grammar closes without another choice.

exact_result: The current grammar forces the admissibility conditions but does not force an observed or constructible wormhole; positive source plus generated link plus complete trace is accepted, and every omission is rejected.
induction_base: One generated adjacency with positive source and complete trace is lawful.
induction_step: Every added mouth/path cell must append its source, causal predecessor and return records.
exclusions: no V1/V2 executable, certificate, answer table or conventional metric equation as a premise
no external measurement, astronomy image or target value selecting a formal survivor
no fitted coupling, chosen curvature, tunable horizon scale or imported normalization
no semantic numerical zero, negative, irrational, imaginary or floating proof quantity
no ungenerated continuum, completed infinity, unrecorded remote adjacency or omitted source ledger
no claim that an astrophysical or engineered traversable wormhole has been observed

witnesses.name: admissible
witnesses.statement: A completely generated positive link passes the formal boundary.
